title: Operator-only gates are labelled and excluded from a client package
proves: Gate 21 reads the operator's intake form, which is deliberately not vendored into a client package. The packager used to copy every case wholesale, so every package shipped with a gate it could never evaluate and ./verify.sh reported an ERR on day one — on the single artifact whose whole job is to let the client prove the thing still works. This asserts both halves stay in step: a case reading operator-only files carries scope=operator, and new-engagement.sh filters on exactly that field.
